scope: tron-shielded proof, verification-context, and pre-ZIP212 note compatibility

parameterSet.authentication: read each exact expected byte range once into an exactly sized owned snapshot while streaming BLAKE2b-512 and size validation; verify the digest before parsing from an in-memory cursor, never seek or reread the writable source

rawBoundary.validation: fixed-width, non-negative, path-marker, and declared-length violations are typed errors before cryptography
rawBoundary.verificationFailure: well-shaped but cryptographically invalid spend/output/final inputs return false
rawBoundary.outputMutation: spend proof, output proof, and signatures copy into caller buffers only after complete success

contexts.ownership: opaque u64 handles own Rust proving or verification contexts
contexts.locking: the table lock covers lookup, atomic slot reservation, removal, and atomic retirement only; each live context has its own mutex
contexts.capacity: reserved_slots counts addressable contexts plus retired contexts with active operations; init atomically reserves only below the maximum, and free releases exactly one slot only after active reaches zero
contexts.retirement: free validates kind, removes the handle and marks its admission state retired atomically under the table lock, then waits for all admitted operations; cloned but unadmitted calls fail InvalidHandle, admitted calls complete before free returns, and unknown, wrong-kind, and double-free handles are typed errors
contexts.verificationCommit: failed checks do not alter accumulated commitments; accepted items commit only after disposable preverification succeeds
contexts.concurrency: different handles can execute concurrently; admitted calls on one handle serialize, retirement does not hold the table lock while waiting, and retiring-active contexts continue consuming capacity until quiesced

notePlaintext.addressPath: ZIP32 external scope and default diversifier/address

excluded: TRC20 contract execution and energy accounting
